Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, nitrite positivity, and presence of bacteria and mucus. Glucosuria is noted, which may suggest hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low urine specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation, assessment for diabetes, and prompt initiation of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
